title: PINN vs Split-Step Fourier for the 1D Schrödinger/GPE: An Honest Benchmark
description: An open-source benchmark comparing Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) against a Strang split-step Fourier reference solver for the 1D Gross-Pitaevskii equation. Rigorously documents PINN failure modes on solitons and long-time dynamics.
